entries.title: Job 23:2
segments: Even to day [is] my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning. {stroke: Heb. hand}

entries.title: Job 23:3
segments: Oh that I knew where I might find him! [that] I might come [even] to his seat!

entries.title: Job 23:4
segments: I would order [my] cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

entries.title: Job 23:5
segments: I would know the words [which] he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.

entries.title: Job 23:6
segments: Will he plead against me with [his] great power? No; but he would put [strength] in me.

entries.title: Job 23:7
segments: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

words.text: with him; so should I be delivered

entries.title: Job 23:8
segments: ¶Behold, I go forward, but he [is] not [there]; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:

entries.title: Job 23:9
segments: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold [him]: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see [him]:

entries.title: Job 23:10
segments: But he knoweth the way that I take: [when] he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold. {that...: Heb. that is with me}

entries.title: Job 23:11
segments: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.

entries.title: Job 23:12
segments: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary [food]. {esteemed: Heb. hid, or, laid up} {my...: or, my appointed portion}

words.text: [food]. {esteemed: Heb. hid, or, laid up} {my...: or, my appointed portion}

entries.title: Job 23:13
segments: ¶But he [is] in one [mind], and who can turn him? and [what] his soul desireth, even [that] he doeth.

entries.title: Job 23:14
segments: For he performeth [the thing that is] appointed for me: and many such [things are] with him.

entries.title: Job 23:15
segments: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.

entries.title: Job 23:16
segments: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:

entries.title: Job 23:17
segments: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, [neither] hath he covered the darkness from my face.

words.text: Because I was not cut off
